name: kn-company-formation
description: Forming a company or other entity in Saint Kitts and Nevis in 2026. Covers the federal company under the Companies Act, Cap. 21.03 (memorandum, certificate, annual return before the end of the month after the anniversary month, directors' accounts, the 2024 agent amendments), and the Nevis routes: domestic company (Companies Ordinance 1999, Forms 26, 1 or 2, 4 and 9), business corporation and LLC through a licensed registered agent with the Financial Services Regulatory Commission, and the new limited partnership (Ordinance 3 of 2025, from 1 February 2026), plus the October 2026 amendment bills and the tax registrations that follow. Trigger phrases include St Kitts company formation, Nevis LLC, Nevis IBC, Nevis limited partnership, register a company in St Kitts.
